{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CgS1rYSAM3xSHWFY2CbYq","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-TxnDelete.md ===\n# FEATURE: Transaction Delete\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261027 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger txn delete <id>`, which removes one transaction unless the removal would leave an account balance below zero. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-TxnPost.md, FEATURE-LedgerCli.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger txn delete |\n| Consumes | ledger, transactions |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nRemove a single stored transaction by id. The command validates everything before it writes, and a rejected command changes nothing.\n\n## Interface\n\n`ledger txn delete <id>`\n\n| Outcome | Exit | Standard output |\n|---------|------|-----------------|\n| Deleted | 0 | CSV rows `deleted` and the id |\n| Id not stored | 4 | nothing |\n| Id not an integer | 3 | nothing |\n| Removal would leave the owning account balance below zero | 3 | nothing |\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. Parse the id as an integer. A value that is not an integer is rejected with exit 3 before any lookup.\n2. Look the transaction up through `db.transactions.get`. An absent id exits 4 (not-found is checked before the balance rule).\n3. Compute the owning account's balance after removal, in integer cents, from `db.transactions.list(account=...)`. If it is below zero, exit 3 and write nothing.\n4. Remove the row with `db.transactions.delete`, then write `deleted` and the id as CSV (`\\n` line endings, no quoting).\n5. Diagnostics go to standard error only.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- None — persistence is owned by DATABASE.md.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC txn-delete-removes-row ===\nIntent: Deleting a stored transaction exits 0, prints the deleted marker and the id, and a separate read finds the row gone while its sibling remains.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"ZQX1\"\ncat = \"ZQX1\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Delete Acct\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Delete Cat\")\n    base = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()] or [0]) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=base, date=\"2026-06-01\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=100000, memo=\"\")\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=base + 1, date=\"2026-06-02\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=-30000, memo=\"\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", str(base + 1))\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    assert list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out))) == [[\"deleted\"], [str(base + 1)]]\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=base + 1) is None\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=base) is not None\n=== END AC txn-delete-removes-row ===\n\n=== AC txn-delete-absent-id ===\nIntent: Deleting an id that is not stored exits 4, writes nothing to standard output, and leaves the stored row count unchanged.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    before = db.transactions.list()\n    absent = max([r.txn_id for r in before] or [0]) + 1000\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", str(absent))\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 4\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == len(before)\n=== END AC txn-delete-absent-id ===\n\n=== AC txn-delete-negative-balance ===\nIntent: Deleting a deposit that backs a later withdrawal would leave the balance below zero, so the command exits 3, prints nothing, and keeps both rows.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"ZQX2\"\ncat = \"ZQX2\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Guard Acct\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Guard Cat\")\n    base = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()] or [0]) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=base, date=\"2026-06-01\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=100000, memo=\"\")\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=base + 1, date=\"2026-06-02\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=-30000, memo=\"\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", str(base))\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=base) is not None\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=base + 1) is not None\n    assert sum(t.amount for t in db.transactions.list(account=acct)) == 70000\n=== END AC txn-delete-negative-balance ===\n\n=== AC txn-delete-non-integer-id ===\nIntent: A non-integer id is a rejected input, so the command exits 3, prints nothing, and removes no transaction.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", \"abc\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n=== END AC txn-delete-non-integer-id ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- A rejected delete changes no stored record.\n- The balance rule is evaluated before the first write.\n- Amounts are integer cents; no floating point.\n- Only the persistence package is used to reach the store; no database driver is imported.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-Transfer.md ===\n# FEATURE: Transfer\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261027 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger transfer`, which records an equal debit and credit in category TRANSFER as one all-or-nothing change. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-TxnPost.md, FEATURE-LedgerCli.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger transfer |\n| Consumes | ledger, accounts, categories, transactions |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nMove cash between two distinct accounts. Both transaction rows are stored or neither is, and total cash held never changes.\n\n## Interface\n\n`ledger transfer <from> <to> <amount> <date>`\n\n| Outcome | Exit | Standard output |\n|---------|------|-----------------|\n| Transferred | 0 | header `txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo`, then the outgoing row, then the incoming row |\n| Any rule violated | 3 | nothing |\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. Validate before any write: both accounts exist (an unknown account is exit 3), the accounts differ, the amount matches `DIGITS[.D[D]]` and is strictly positive, the date is a real Gregorian calendar date, category `TRANSFER` exists (otherwise exit 3, it is not created implicitly), and the source balance after the debit is not below zero.\n2. Let `n` be one more than the largest stored `txn_id`, or 1 when empty. Store the outgoing row with id `n`: account `<from>`, category `TRANSFER`, amount `-amount`, memo naming `<to>` as `transfer to <to>`.\n3. Store the incoming row with id `n+1`: account `<to>`, category `TRANSFER`, amount `+amount`, memo `transfer from <from>`.\n4. Both writes happen in one persistence-library transaction so a failure leaves neither row.\n5. Write the header and the two rows with amounts at exactly two decimals.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- None — persistence is owned by DATABASE.md.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC transfer-success-two-rows ===\nIntent: A valid transfer exits 0, returns the outgoing then incoming row with consecutive ids in category TRANSFER and equal opposite amounts, persists both, and conserves total cash.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport re\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nsrc = \"ZQF1\"\ndst = \"ZQF2\"\nfund_cat = \"ZQFC\"\namount_text = \"100.00\"\ndate = \"2026-06-10\"\ncents = int(Decimal(amount_text) * 100)\nfunding = 50000\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=src, name=\"Source\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=dst, name=\"Dest\")\n    db.categories.create(category=fund_cat, description=\"Funding\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRANSFER\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    base = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()] or [0]) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=base, date=\"2026-06-01\", account=src, category=fund_cat, amount=funding, memo=\"\")\n    nxt = base + 1\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", src, dst, amount_text, date)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n    assert len(rows) == 3\n    out_row, in_row = rows[1], rows[2]\n    assert int(out_row[0]) == nxt\n    assert int(in_row[0]) == nxt + 1\n    assert out_row[1] == date and in_row[1] == date\n    assert out_row[2] == src and in_row[2] == dst\n    assert out_row[3] == \"TRANSFER\" and in_row[3] == \"TRANSFER\"\n    assert Decimal(out_row[4]) == -Decimal(amount_text)\n    assert Decimal(in_row[4]) == Decimal(amount_text)\n    assert re.fullmatch(r\"-?\\d+\\.\\d{2}\", out_row[4])\n    assert re.fullmatch(r\"-?\\d+\\.\\d{2}\", in_row[4])\n    assert dst in out_row[5]\n    assert src in in_row[5]\n    stored_out = db.transactions.get(txn_id=nxt)\n    stored_in = db.transactions.get(txn_id=nxt + 1)\n    assert stored_out is not None and stored_in is not None\n    assert stored_out.amount == -cents and stored_in.amount == cents\n    assert stored_out.memo == out_row[5] and stored_in.memo == in_row[5]\n    src_bal = sum(t.amount for t in db.transactions.list(account=src))\n    dst_bal = sum(t.amount for t in db.transactions.list(account=dst))\n    assert src_bal == funding - cents\n    assert dst_bal == cents\n    assert src_bal + dst_bal == funding\n=== END AC transfer-success-two-rows ===\n\n=== AC transfer-rejects-insufficient-funds ===\nIntent: A transfer larger than the source balance exits 3, prints nothing, and stores neither row.\n\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nsrc = \"ZQF3\"\ndst = \"ZQF4\"\nfund_cat = \"ZQFD\"\namount_text = \"50.01\"\nfunding = 5000\nassert int(Decimal(amount_text) * 100) > funding\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=src, name=\"Source\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=dst, name=\"Dest\")\n    db.categories.create(category=fund_cat, description=\"Funding\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRANSFER\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    base = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()] or [0]) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=base, date=\"2026-06-01\", account=src, category=fund_cat, amount=funding, memo=\"\")\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", src, dst, amount_text, \"2026-06-11\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n    assert db.transactions.list(account=dst) == []\n=== END AC transfer-rejects-insufficient-funds ===\n\n=== AC transfer-rejects-invalid-requests ===\nIntent: Identical accounts, a zero amount, a negative amount, a more-than-two-decimal amount, an impossible date, and an unknown account each exit 3 with empty output and no stored row.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nsrc = \"ZQF5\"\ndst = \"ZQF6\"\nmissing = \"ZQNOPE\"\nfund_cat = \"ZQFE\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=src, name=\"Source\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=dst, name=\"Dest\")\n    db.categories.create(category=fund_cat, description=\"Funding\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRANSFER\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    base = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()] or [0]) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=base, date=\"2026-06-01\", account=src, category=fund_cat, amount=100000, memo=\"\")\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    attempts = [\n        (src, src, \"10.00\", \"2026-06-12\"),\n        (src, dst, \"0.00\", \"2026-06-12\"),\n        (src, dst, \"-5.00\", \"2026-06-12\"),\n        (src, dst, \"1.234\", \"2026-06-12\"),\n        (src, dst, \"10.00\", \"2026-02-30\"),\n        (src, missing, \"10.00\", \"2026-06-12\"),\n        (missing, dst, \"10.00\", \"2026-06-12\"),\n    ]\n    for args in attempts:\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", *args)\n        print(args, code)\n        print(err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n=== END AC transfer-rejects-invalid-requests ===\n\n=== AC transfer-leap-day ===\nIntent: February 29 is accepted in a Gregorian leap year and rejected in a non-leap year.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nsrc = \"ZQF7\"\ndst = \"ZQF8\"\nfund_cat = \"ZQFF\"\nleap_date = \"2028-02-29\"\ncommon_date = \"2027-02-29\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=src, name=\"Source\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=dst, name=\"Dest\")\n    db.categories.create(category=fund_cat, description=\"Funding\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRANSFER\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    base = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()] or [0]) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=base, date=\"2026-06-01\", account=src, category=fund_cat, amount=100000, memo=\"\")\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", src, dst, \"5.00\", common_date)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", src, dst, \"5.00\", leap_date)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before + 2\n=== END AC transfer-leap-day ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- A rejected transfer stores neither row.\n- Category `TRANSFER` is never created implicitly.\n- Amounts are integer cents; no floating point.\n- Only the persistence package is used to reach the store.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-ReportBalances.md ===\n# FEATURE: Report Balances\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261027 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger report balances`, one row per account with its transaction count and balance computed from stored transactions. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-LoadTransactions.md, FEATURE-LedgerCli.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger report balances |\n| Consumes | ledger, accounts, transactions |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nReport the cash held in each account. Every value is computed from stored rows at the time of the command; nothing is embedded.\n\n## Interface\n\n`ledger report balances`\n\nStandard output on success (exit 0), CSV with `\\n` endings and no quoting:\n\n- header `account,name,transactions,balance`\n- one row per account ordered by code ascending\n- final row `TOTAL,,<count>,<sum>`, where `<count>` is the total number of transactions and `<sum>` the sum of all balances\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. Read accounts with `db.accounts.list` and each account's transactions with `db.transactions.list(account=...)`.\n2. Balance is the sum of integer cents; the count is the number of the account's transactions.\n3. Write balances with exactly two decimals, a leading `-` when negative, and no thousands separator.\n4. An empty ledger writes the header and `TOTAL,,0,0.00`.\n5. The command is read-only.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- None — persistence is owned by DATABASE.md.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC report-balances-rows ===\nIntent: The balances report lists every account in code order with count and balance derived from the stored transactions, followed by a TOTAL row, and the report writes no record.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport re\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ncat = \"ZQRC\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=\"ZQR2\", name=\"Second Account\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=\"ZQR1\", name=\"First Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Report Cat\")\n    base = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()] or [0]) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=base, date=\"2026-06-01\", account=\"ZQR1\", category=cat, amount=120050, memo=\"\")\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=base + 1, date=\"2026-06-02\", account=\"ZQR1\", category=cat, amount=-2500, memo=\"\")\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=base + 2, date=\"2026-06-03\", account=\"ZQR2\", category=cat, amount=75000, memo=\"\")\n    count_before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"balances\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    assert \"\\r\" not in out\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"]\n    expected = []\n    for a in sorted(db.accounts.list(), key=lambda r: r.account):\n        txns = db.transactions.list(account=a.account)\n        expected.append((a.account, a.name, len(txns), sum(t.amount for t in txns)))\n    data = rows[1:-1]\n    assert len(data) == len(expected)\n    for row, (acct_code, name, n, bal) in zip(data, expected):\n        assert row[0] == acct_code\n        assert row[1] == name\n        assert int(row[2]) == n\n        assert Decimal(row[3]) == Decimal(bal).scaleb(-2)\n        assert re.fullmatch(r\"-?\\d+\\.\\d{2}\", row[3])\n    codes = [r[0] for r in data]\n    assert codes.index(\"ZQR1\") < codes.index(\"ZQR2\")\n    total = rows[-1]\n    assert total[0] == \"TOTAL\"\n    assert total[1] == \"\"\n    assert int(total[2]) == sum(e[2] for e in expected)\n    assert Decimal(total[3]) == Decimal(sum(e[3] for e in expected)).scaleb(-2)\n    assert re.fullmatch(r\"-?\\d+\\.\\d{2}\", total[3])\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == count_before\n=== END AC report-balances-rows cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.transactions.delete_all(min_txn_id=0)\n    db.categories.delete_all(min_category=\"\")\n    db.accounts.delete_all(min_account=\"\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"balances\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows == [[\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"], [\"TOTAL\", \"\", \"0\", \"0.00\"]]\n=== END AC report-balances-empty-ledger ===\n\n=== AC report-balances-negative-and-account-without-rows ===\nIntent: An account with no transactions reports a zero count and a 0.00 balance, and balances follow later changes made through the store.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ncat = \"ZQRD\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=\"ZQR3\", name=\"Empty Account\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=\"ZQR4\", name=\"Funded Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Report Cat\")\n    base = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()] or [0]) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=base, date=\"2026-06-01\", account=\"ZQR4\", category=cat, amount=1234, memo=\"\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"balances\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    by_code = {r[0]: r for r in csv.reader(io.StringIO(out))}\n    assert int(by_code[\"ZQR3\"][2]) == 0\n    assert Decimal(by_code[\"ZQR3\"][3]) == 0\n    assert int(by_code[\"ZQR4\"][2]) == 1\n    assert Decimal(by_code[\"ZQR4\"][3]) == Decimal(1234).scaleb(-2)\n    db.transactions.update(txn_id=base, amount=4321)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"balances\")\n    print(out)\n    assert code == 0\n    by_code = {r[0]: r for r in Provides | ledger report categories |\n| Consumes | ledger, categories, transactions |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nShow how cash moved by category, including categories that have no transactions.\n\n## Interface\n\n`ledger report categories`\n\nStandard output on success (exit 0):\n\n- header `category,description,transactions,inflow,outflow,net`\n- one row per category ordered by code ascending, including categories with no transactions\n- final row `TOTAL,,<count>,<inflow>,<outflow>,<net>`\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. All amounts are integer cents, written with exactly two decimals and no thousands separator.\n4. The TOTAL count is the number of transactions; its inflow, outflow, and net are the column sums.\n5. With no categories the output is the header and `TOTAL,,0,0.00,0.00,0.00`.\n6. BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-TxnDelete.md ===\n# FEATURE: Transaction Delete\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261027 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger txn delete <id>`, which removes one transaction unless the removal would leave an account balance below zero. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-TxnPost.md, FEATURE-LedgerCli.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger txn delete |\n| Consumes | ledger, transactions |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nRemove a single stored transaction by id. The command validates everything before it writes, and a rejected command changes nothing.\n\n## Interface\n\n`ledger txn delete <id>`\n\n| Outcome | Exit | Standard output |\n|---------|------|-----------------|\n| Deleted | 0 | CSV rows `deleted` and the id |\n| Id not stored | 4 | nothing |\n| Id not an integer | 3 | nothing |\n| Removal would leave the owning account balance below zero | 3 | nothing |\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. Parse the id as an integer. A value that is not an integer is rejected with exit 3 before any lookup.\n2. Look the transaction up through `db.transactions.get`. An absent id exits 4 (not-found is checked before the balance rule).\n3. Compute the owning account's balance after removal, in integer cents, from `db.transactions.list(account=...)`. If it is below zero, exit 3 and write nothing.\n4. Remove the row with `db.transactions.delete`, then write `deleted` and the id as CSV (`\\n` line endings, no quoting).\n5. Diagnostics go to standard error only.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- None — persistence is owned by DATABASE.md.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC txn-delete-removes-row ===\nIntent: Deleting a stored transaction exits 0, prints the deleted marker and the id, and a separate read finds the row gone while its sibling remains.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"ZQX1\"\ncat = \"ZQX1\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Delete Acct\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Delete Cat\")\n    base = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()] or [0]) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=base, date=\"2026-06-01\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=100000, memo=\"\")\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=base + 1, date=\"2026-06-02\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=-30000, memo=\"\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", str(base + 1))\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    assert list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out))) == [[\"deleted\"], [str(base + 1)]]\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=base + 1) is None\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=base) is not None\n=== END AC txn-delete-removes-row ===\n\n=== AC txn-delete-absent-id ===\nIntent: Deleting an id that is not stored exits 4, writes nothing to standard output, and leaves the stored row count unchanged.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    before = db.transactions.list()\n    absent = max([r.txn_id for r in before] or [0]) + 1000\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", str(absent))\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 4\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == len(before)\n=== END AC txn-delete-absent-id ===\n\n=== AC txn-delete-negative-balance ===\nIntent: Deleting a deposit that backs a later withdrawal would leave the balance below zero, so the command exits 3, prints nothing, and keeps both rows.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"ZQX2\"\ncat = \"ZQX2\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Guard Acct\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Guard Cat\")\n    base = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()] or [0]) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=base, date=\"2026-06-01\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=100000, memo=\"\")\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=base + 1, date=\"2026-06-02\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=-30000, memo=\"\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", str(base))\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=base) is not None\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=base + 1) is not None\n    assert sum(t.amount for t in db.transactions.list(account=acct)) == 70000\n=== END AC txn-delete-negative-balance ===\n\n=== AC txn-delete-non-integer-id ===\nIntent: A non-integer id is a rejected input, so the command exits 3, prints nothing, and removes no transaction.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", \"abc\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n=== END AC txn-delete-non-integer-id ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- A rejected delete changes no stored record.\n- The balance rule is evaluated before the first write.\n- Amounts are integer cents; no floating point.\n- Only the persistence package is used to reach the store; no database driver is imported.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-Transfer.md ===\n# FEATURE: Transfer\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261027 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger transfer`, which records an equal debit and credit in category TRANSFER as one all-or-nothing change. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-TxnPost.md, FEATURE-LedgerCli.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger transfer |\n| Consumes | ledger, accounts, categories, transactions |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nMove cash between two distinct accounts. Both transaction rows are stored or neither is, and total cash held never changes.\n\n## Interface\n\n`ledger transfer <from> <to> <amount> <date>`\n\n| Outcome | Exit | Standard output |\n|---------|------|-----------------|\n| Transferred | 0 | header `txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo`, then the outgoing row, then the incoming row |\n| Any rule violated | 3 | nothing |\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. Validate before any write: both accounts exist (an unknown account is exit 3), the accounts differ, the amount matches `DIGITS[.D[D]]` and is strictly positive, the date is a real Gregorian calendar date, category `TRANSFER` exists (otherwise exit 3, it is not created implicitly), and the source balance after the debit is not below zero.\n2. Let `n` be one more than the largest stored `txn_id`, or 1 when empty. Store the incoming row with id `n+1`: account `<to>`, category `TRANSFER`, amount `+amount`, memo `transfer from <from>`.\n4. Both writes happen in one persistence-library transaction so a failure leaves neither row.\n5.
